name: Patch Latest Worker Version
description: Patch Latest Worker Version Only `/versions/latest` is supported. PATCH /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/workers/workers/{worker_id}/versions/latest
context:
PATCH /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/workers/workers/{worker_id}/versions/latest
Only `/versions/latest` is supported. Creates a new Worker version by applying a JSON Merge Patch (RFC 7396) to the latest version. Patching a specific version ID is not supported. Omitted fields are inherited from the latest version.
Required: account_id (path); worker_id (path)
Optional: deploy (query); body (body) — JSON Merge Patch to apply to the latest version. An empty object creates a new version with no changes.
